---------1.) Initial script for joining
SELECT 
    TOP 500
    A.ORGKEY, A.NAME, C.ACID, c.FORACID, D.PART_TRAN_TYPE, E.SOURCE_APP_CODE
    ,SUM(D.TRAN_AMT) AS Transaction_Amount
    FROM busc.CRM_ACCOUNTS A
    LEFT JOIN busc.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP B ON A.CORE_CUST_ID = B.CUST_ID AND A.BANK_ID = B.BANK_ID
    LEFT JOIN busc.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER C ON B.ACID = C.ACID AND B.BANK_ID = C.BANK_ID
    LEFT JOIN busc.DEP_HISTTRANDTLTABLE D ON B.ACID = C.ACID AND B.BANK_ID = D.BANK_ID
    LEFT JOIN busc.DEP_CUSTOMCHANNELTRANSTABLE E ON D.TRAN_ID = E.TRAN_ID AND D.BANK_ID = E.BANK_ID
    WHERE 
    A.IsLatest = 1 AND B.IsLatest = 1 AND C.IsLatest = 1 AND D.IsLatest = 1 AND E.IsLatest = 1
    AND YEAR(D.TRAN_DATE) = '2022' AND YEAR(E.TRAN_DATE) = '2022'
    GROUP BY
    A.ORGKEY, A.NAME, C.ACID, C.FORACID, D.PART_TRAN_TYPE, E.SOURCE_APP_CODE
    ORDER BY A.NAME, D.PART_TRAN_TYPE, E.SOURCE_APP_CODE

SELECT TOP 10 * FROM busc.DEP_HISTTRANDTLTABLE
SELECT TOP 10 * FROM busc.DEP_CUSTOMCHANNELTRANSTABLE 
SELECT DISTINCT(SOURCE_APP_CODE) FROM busc.DEP_CUSTOMCHANNELTRANSTABLE
---SELECT TOP 10 * FROM

---Data Profiling: Count, File Names, Transaction Dates
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM busc.DEP_HISTTRANDTLTABLE ---150,003
SELECT DISTINCT(FILE_NAME) FROM busc.DEP_HISTTRANDTLTABLE --- 20221031, 20221210, 20221224
SELECT DISTINCT(TRAN_DATE) FROM busc.DEP_HISTTRANDTLTABLE ORDER BY TRAN_DATE ---2022-10-03 to 2022-12-23
SELECT TRAN_DATE, COUNT(*) FROM busc.DEP_HISTTRANDTLTABLE GROUP BY TRAN_DATE ORDER BY TRAN_DATE ---2022-10-03 to 2022-12-23
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM busc.DEP_CUSTOMCHANNELTRANSTABLE --- 100,001
SELECT DISTINCT(FILE_NAME) FROM busc.DEP_CUSTOMCHANNELTRANSTABLE --- 20220108, 20220115, 20220122
SELECT TRAN_DATE, COUNT(*) FROM busc.DEP_CUSTOMCHANNELTRANSTABLE GROUP BY TRAN_DATE ORDER BY TRAN_DATE ---2022-01-03 to 2022-01-21

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM busc.DEP_HISTTRANDTLTABLE A LEFT JOIN busc.DEP_CUSTOMCHANNELTRANSTABLE B ON A.TRAN_ID = B.TRAN_ID AND A.BANK_ID = B.BANK_ID

SELECT TOP 500 PARTTRAN_NUM, right(replicate(' ',4) + PARTTRAN_NUM,4) FROM busc.DEP_CUSTOMCHANNELTRANSTABLE
SELECT dISTINCT PART_TRAN_SRL_NUM FROM busc.DEP_HISTTRANDTLTABLE ORDER BY PART_TRAN_SRL_NUM

SELECT TOP 100
    D.BANK_ID, D.TRAN_ID, D.TRAN_DATE, D.PART_TRAN_TYPE, D.PART_TRAN_SRL_NUM 
    ,E.BANK_ID, E.TRAN_ID, E.TRAN_DATE, E.PARTTRAN_IND, E.PARTTRAN_NUM
    FROM busc.DEP_HISTTRANDTLTABLE D
    INNER JOIN busc.DEP_CUSTOMCHANNELTRANSTABLE E ON D.PART_TRAN_SRL_NUM = right(replicate(' ',4) + PARTTRAN_NUM,4)

SELECT TOP 10 
    D.BANK_ID, D.TRAN_ID, D.TRAN_DATE, D.PART_TRAN_TYPE, D.PART_TRAN_SRL_NUM 
    ,E.BANK_ID, E.TRAN_ID, E.TRAN_DATE, E.PARTTRAN_IND, E.PARTTRAN_NUM	
    FROM busc.DEP_HISTTRANDTLTABLE D
    LEFT JOIN busc.DEP_CUSTOMCHANNELTRANSTABLE E ON D.TRAN_ID = E.TRAN_ID AND D.BANK_ID = E.BANK_ID AND D.TRAN_DATE = E.TRAN_DATE AND D.PART_TRAN_TYPE = E.PARTTRAN_IND
    WHERE D.DEL_FLG != 'Y' AND E.BANK_ID IS NOT NULL AND E.TRAN_DATE != '1900-01-01'

SELECT DISTINCT TRAN_ID FROM busc.DEP_HISTTRANDTLTABLE ORDER BY TRAN_ID

---------------------------------------
SELECT 
    TOP 500
    A.ORGKEY, A.NAME, C.ACID, c.FORACID, D.PART_TRAN_TYPE, E.SOURCE_APP_CODE
    ,D.TRAN_AMT AS Transaction_Amount
    FROM busc.CRM_ACCOUNTS A
    LEFT JOIN busc.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP B ON A.CORE_CUST_ID = B.CUST_ID AND A.BANK_ID = B.BANK_ID
    LEFT JOIN busc.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER C ON B.ACID = C.ACID AND B.BANK_ID = C.BANK_ID
    LEFT JOIN busc.DEP_HISTTRANDTLTABLE D ON B.ACID = C.ACID AND B.BANK_ID = D.BANK_ID
    LEFT JOIN busc.DEP_CUSTOMCHANNELTRANSTABLE E ON D.TRAN_ID = E.TRAN_ID AND D.BANK_ID = E.BANK_ID AND D.TRAN_DATE = E.TRAN_DATE AND D.PART_TRAN_TYPE = E.PARTTRAN_IND AND D.PART_TRAN_SRL_NUM = right(replicate(' ',4) + PARTTRAN_NUM,4)
    WHERE A.IsLatest = 1 AND B.IsLatest = 1 AND C.IsLatest = 1 AND D.IsLatest = 1 ---AND E.IsLatest = 1
    ---AND YEAR(D.TRAN_DATE) = '2022' AND YEAR(E.TRAN_DATE) = '2022' 
    AND D.DEL_FLG != 'Y' ---AND A.ORGKEY = 'C00011279'
